entries.name: Overview
entries.summary: What Kex is, and what it is for.
entries.text: Kex is a functional language with Ruby-like syntax, immutability by default, and an Elixir-style process model.

entries.name: Values
entries.summary: Everything is a value, and values are immutable unless you say otherwise: let name = " world " IO . printLine ( " hello, ${ name } " ) Immutability is the default, not a mode. var opts out of it for o…
entries.text: Everything is a value, and values are immutable unless you say otherwise: let name = " world " IO . printLine ( " hello, ${ name } " ) Immutability is the default, not a mode. var opts out of it for one binding.

entries.name: Syntax
entries.text: A one-line block uses braces; a multi-line block uses do ... end . let doubled = xs . map { | x | x * 2 }

entries.name: Kex documentation
entries.summary: The Kex guide and the reference for its standard library and Tey.
entries.text: Kex is a functional language with Ruby-like syntax, immutability by default, and an Elixir-style process model. Guide — the language, from the first value to processes. Standard Library — every module, type and trait that ships with Kex, generated from its source. Tey — the package manager and build tool. Machine-readable entry points: llms.txt and llms-full.txt .
